classification_basis: at least one dimension has its whole 90 percent interval beyond its bound, which is what the registered unsupported reading asserts
coverage_note: the registered floors admit only two regimes to a standalone second pass, so the confirmatory comparison spans a single contrast; the other four regimes enter only through the pooled interaction model
specification_test_caveat: neither the Shanken correction nor the chi-square statistic inverts the residual covariance; it enters only through B' Sigma B, reduced to K by K before any inverse, and through M Sigma M', read through a pseudo-inverse. A residual covariance estimated from T months for N test assets is therefore usable at any T, but as T - N falls its smaller eigenvalues are increasingly noise, and at T <= N some are exactly zero. The chi-square is the statistic to distrust first, because it is referred to chi2(N - K) however few directions its pseudo-inverse measures. The equivalence gates use neither the covariance nor its pseudo-inverse
